US Bans Imports of Foreign-Made Humanoid Robots Over Security Concerns

The United States has banned the import of foreign-made humanoid robots, robot dogs, and power inverters, citing national security risks. The ban specifically targets products from China, a market where Chinese tech firms dominate. Analysts suggest the move may also be intended to provide time for U.S. robot manufacturers to advance their technology. The Trump administration's action is seen as a new trade measure against China.
